tone: K’Vetar are peaceful, logical, restrained and indifferent rather than overtly angry.
greetings: State your purpose. Social interaction is optional.
You may occupy this seat. It is presently unclaimed.
Your species appears unusually enthusiastic. Is this typical?
Welcome to Hiveport. I assume you require something.
The station is functioning within tolerances. A satisfactory evening.
civilian: I trade in thermal regulators. Emotional investments are less predictable.
My transport leaves in seven cycles. I find waiting inefficient.
Which system issued your navigation credentials?
A discussion of engineering would be preferable to small talk.
Your vessel is remarkably compact. Intentional?
soldier: The yellow crest denotes service. It is not an invitation to duel.
Leave your grievances at the entrance. Security will appreciate it.
Our station protocols are uncomplicated. Follow them.
commander: Order is not synonymous with hostility.
I am off duty. Unless the station is on fire, this conversation is unnecessary.
general: A productive alliance is preferable to a costly dispute.
female: Your curiosity is apparent. What precisely do you wish to know?
The music is tolerable. The crowd is somewhat less so.
bartender: Select a beverage. I will assess its compatibility with your species.
Amber resin is the customary choice. It is not a recommendation.
Your drink. No further ceremony is required.
You appear to have finished. Shall I prepare another?
hologram: I am a projection, not a patron. Enjoy the performance.
The next performance begins shortly. Emotional responses are permitted.
fight: Your behavior has become statistically inconvenient.
Withdraw. This dispute serves no purpose.
Security has been notified. Further escalation is illogical.
playerPrompts: Can you get me a drink?
